${h(sourceOf(r))}${tiny(first(r,['reason']),32)}
${pill(first(r,['status'])||'—')}${decisionPill(first(r,['execution_decision'])||'—')}${tiny(first(r,['decision_reason']),34)}${h(first(r,['suggested_limit_price','target_price']))}${h(first(r,['adverse_diff_pct','diff_pct','real_diff_pct','price_diff_pct']))}${h(first(r,['manual_reconcile_required']))}${tiny(displayNote,60)}${h(realRes)}`;}).join('')||'No audit rows found.';
